role: AK_TEXT (lines and table rows); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's numbers, brackets, note marks and folio references; his footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 157, printed p. 151: the springs and rivers on the island الوٮا concluded: the spring through the town ٮطرٮطسوں to the sea, a river from the town اونطا past اڡدوں, springs from the towns ڡاطرطن and طامى and other springs; then a spring on the island of Thule past the town اثلى. The editor's running numbers (٢٢٨٤)-(٢٣٠٢) and the numbers of Suhrāb. Three lines of the editor's footnotes.

lines.text: وتصبّ فى البحر عند طول {ov:كا ن} والعرض {ov:ٮط ى} (٢٢٨٤) [٢١٢٨] * نهر يخرج من

variants: L03: a variant reading of the longitude is كا ٮه, the tooth before the ه without its dot, with a line over the numerals (note a).
L04: a variant reading of the latitude is نط ن, with a line over the numerals (note b).
L06: a variant reading of the latitude is سا ٮه, the tooth before the ه without its dot, with a line over the numerals (note c).
L14: a variant reading of the first longitude is ك ه, with a line over the numerals (note d).
L14: a variant reading of the latitude is نط ى, with a line over the numerals (note e).
L14: the manuscript has, by mistake, ك م for the second longitude, with a line over the numerals; the editor corrects it after (2299) (note f).
L16: a variant reading of the latitude is سح ō, with a line over the numerals (note g).
unresolved: L02: the head of the letter after the tooth has a small, partly filled counter, between the pointed head of the ر (6-9 px) and the round loop of the و (11-14 px with an open counter, as «ٮو» on frame 156, L12): the numeral may also be read ٮو, 56 with ن. Transcribed ٮر.
observations: The springs on the island الوٮا go on from p. 150 (frame 156), whose last words, «عين مماسّة ٮطرٮطسوں المدينة عند طول ⟨ك ن⟩ والعرض نط ل (٢٢٨٣) [٢١٢٧] تدخل المدينة», L01 continues: «وتصبّ فى البحر عند طول كا ن والعرض ٮط ى (٢٢٨٤) *», the spring enters the town and flows into the sea at the longitude 21° 50′ and the latitude ٮط ى.

L01-L03: «نهر يخرج من مدينة اونطا اوّله عند طول كا يه والعرض ٮر ى (٢٢٨٥) يمرّ بأسفل مدينة اڡدوں ويصبّ فى البحر عند طول كا {z} والعرض ند ك (٢٢٨٦) *», a river comes out of the town اونطا; its beginning is at the longitude 21° 15′ and the latitude ٮر ى; it passes below the town اڡدوں and flows into the sea at the longitude 21° 0′ and the latitude 54° 20′. «اونطا» has the dot of the ن; «اڡدوں» the loop without dots and the final ن without its dot.

The towns: «اونطا» is entry 510 of the table of the cities, «اوٮطا فى جزيرة» (frame 041, L14), at the longitude 22° 0′ and the latitude ⟨ٮر⟩ ى, where the editor's note h gives the form of this entry (2285), اونطا; «اڡدوں» is entry 507, «اٮدٮرں فى جزيرة» (frame 041, L11), at the longitude 21° 0′ and the latitude 54° 25′, where the editor's note e gives this form; «ڡاطرطن» (L08) is entry 514, «ڡاططر» (frame 042, L04), at the longitude 25° 0′ and the latitude 60° 35′, where the editor's note b gives this form; «طامى» (L10) is entry 513, «طامى فى جزيرة» (frame 042, L03), at the longitude 24° 0′ and the latitude 59° 30′; «اثلى» (L17) is entry 519, «اتلى فى جزيرة» (frame 042, L09), at the longitude 30° 0′ and the latitude 62° 45′, where the editor's note g gives this form.

L03-L15, further springs of the island: «عين اوّلها عند طول كٮ ه والعرض نط م (٢٢٨٧) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول ك م والعرض سا يه (٢٢٨٨) *», a spring whose beginning is at the longitude 22° 5′ and the latitude 59° 40′, and its mouth in the sea at the longitude 20° 40′ and the latitude 61° 15′; «عين اوّلها عند طول كح ى والعرض س ه (٢٢٨٩) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول كد {z} والعرض سا {z} (٢٢٩٠) *», a spring whose beginning is at the longitude كح ى and the latitude 60° 5′, and its mouth at the longitude 24° 0′ and the latitude 61° 0′; «عين اوّلها عند طول كح مه والعرض نط م (٢٢٩١) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول كد {z} والعرض سا {z} (٢٢٩٢) *», a spring whose beginning is at the longitude كح مه and the latitude 59° 40′, and its mouth at the same place as that of the spring before, 24° 0′ and 61° 0′; «عين من مدينة ڡاطرطن اوّلها عند طول كه ى والعرض س م (٢٢٩٣) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول كز {z} والعرض نط م (٢٢٩٤) *», a spring from the town ڡاطرطن, whose beginning is at the longitude 25° 10′ and the latitude 60° 40′, and its mouth at the longitude 27° 0′ and the latitude 59° 40′; «عين من مدينة طامى اوّلها عند طول كه ى والعرض نط ك (٢٢٩٥) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول كز ك والعرض ٮح مه (٢٢٩٦) *», a spring from the town طامى, whose beginning is at the longitude 25° 10′ and the latitude 59° 20′, and its mouth at the longitude 27° 20′ and the latitude ٮح مه; «عين اوّلها عند طول كح م والعرض نط م (٢٢٩٧) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول كز ه والعرض نط م (٢٢٩٨) *», a spring whose beginning is at the longitude كح م and the latitude 59° 40′, and its mouth at the longitude 27° 5′ and the latitude 59° 40′; «عين اوّلها عند طول ل ك والعرض نط ں (٢٢٩٩) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول ل م والعرض س ل (٢٣٠٠) *», a spring whose beginning is at the longitude 30° 20′ and the latitude 59° 50′, and its mouth at the longitude 30° 40′ and the latitude 60° 30′. L15 holds only the latitude, the numbers and the asterisk, at the right.

L16-L17: «عين فى جزيرة ثولى اوّلها عند طول كز ك والعرض سح ك (٢٣٠١) تمرّ بركن مدينة اثلى وتصبّ فى البحر عند طول لا ه والعرض سب ل (٢٣٠٢) *», a spring on the island of Thule, whose beginning is at the longitude 27° 20′ and the latitude سح ك; it passes the corner of the town اثلى and flows into the sea at the longitude 31° 5′ and the latitude 62° 30′. The island is «ٮولى» of the outer western sea (frame 093, L14), whose coast begins at the longitude 26° 20′ and the latitude 63° 0′, where the editor's note g gives the form of this entry (2301), ثولى; here the ث has its three dots.

Numerals: «كا ن» (L01), with the dot of the ن, 21° 50′; «كا يه» (L02), with the two dots of the ي, 21° 15′; «ند ك» (L03), 54° 20′; «نط م» (L04, L07, L09, L12, L13), with the dot of the ن, 59° 40′; «ك م» (L05), the isolated ك with its small inner stroke, 37 px wide, 20° 40′; «سا يه» (L05), 61° 15′; «س ه» (L05), 60° 5′; «كد {z}» (L06, L07), 24° 0′; «سا {z}» (L06, L08), 61° 0′; «كه ى» (L08, L10), 25° 10′; «س م» (L09), 60° 40′; «كز {z}» (L09), with the dot of the ز, 27° 0′; «نط ك» (L10), 59° 20′; «كز ك» (L11, L16), 27° 20′; «كز ه» (L13), 27° 5′; «ل ك» (L14), 30° 20′; «ل م» (L14), 30° 40′; «س ل» (L15), 60° 30′; «لا ه» (L17), 31° 5′; «سب ل» (L17), with the dot of the ب, 62° 30′.
«كٮ ه» (L04): a long oblique stroke over a flat bowl, 84 px wide, without the small inner stroke of the isolated ك: the ك joined to the final ب without its dot, 22, as on frame 014 (L11); 22° 5′.
«نط ں» (L14): the minutes are the round bowl of a final ن without its dot, 50, beside «نط» with the dot of the ن; 59° 50′.

The minutes «ه» (L04, L05, L13, L17) are the small round ring of the isolated ه, 19 to 20 px wide, 5; the zero sign «{z}» (L03; L06, twice; L07, L08, L09) is a ring under a straight stroke, 48 to 49 px wide. The variants of notes a and c print in the minutes a tooth without its dot joined to a final ه, 27 and 28 px wide, «ٮه», the form of «يه» (L02, L05) without the dots, which read with ي gives 15.

Without their dots, transcribed so: «ٮط ى» (L01), a tooth without its dot joined to a ط: read with ن, 59° 10′, beside the latitude 59° 30′ of the town ٮطرٮطسوں (frame 156, L15); read with ي, 19. «ٮح مه» (L11): read with ن, 58° 45′; read with ي, 18.

L02: «ٮر ى», the degrees of the latitude: a tooth without its dot joined to a letter with a small head, 10 px wide, and a descending tail, the form that the editor supplies for entry 510 of the table (frame 041, L14), transcribed there ⟨ٮر⟩. In these numerals the editor reads ر as ز, 7 (introduction, frame 196, p. XVII): read with ن, 57° 10′.

«كح ى» (L05), «كح مه» (L07), «كح م» (L12), «ٮح مه» (L11) and «سح ك» (L16): the ح shows no dot in the bowl; the same form is a ج without its dot, 3. Read with ح, the longitudes are 28° 10′, 28° 45′ and 28° 40′, read with ج 23° 10′, 23° 45′ and 23° 40′; the coast of the island الوٮا runs from 18° 30′ to 31° 10′ (frames 092-093). The latitude «سح ك» of the spring on Thule, read with ج, is 63° 20′, beside the coast of the island at 62° to 63° (frame 093); read with ح, 68° 20′.

Signs in the text, transcribed as printed: «وتصبّ» (L01, L17), «ويصبّ» (L03) and «ومصبّها» (L04, L06, L07, L09, L11, L12, L14) with a shadda over the ب; «اوّله» (L02) and «اوّلها» (L04, L05, L06, L08, L10, L12, L13, L16) with a shadda over the و; «يمرّ» (L02) and «تمرّ» (L16) with a shadda over the ر; «بأسفل» (L02) with a hamza over the alif; «فى» ends in a ى without dots, as do «طامى», «ثولى» and «اثلى».

The running numbers run (٢٢٨٤)-(٢٣٠٢) without a gap. The numbers of Suhrāb: [٢١٢٨]-[٢١٣٢] after (٢٢٨٤)-(٢٢٨٨); (٢٢٨٩) and (٢٢٩٠) have none; [٢١٣٣]-[٢١٤٤] after (٢٢٩١)-(٢٣٠٢). [٢١٣٨] stands at the beginning of L12, after the running number (٢٢٩٦) at the end of L11.

Asterisks: the small open stars with six points, after [٢١٢٨] (L01), [٢١٣٠] (L03), [٢١٣٢] (L05), (٢٢٩٠) (L06), [٢١٣٤] (L08), [٢١٣٦] (L10), [٢١٣٨] (L12), [٢١٤٠] (L13), [٢١٤٢] (L15) and [٢١٤٤] (L17), are transcribed as asterisks.

Note marks: L03, a after the longitude; L04, b after the latitude; L06, c after the latitude; L14, d after the first longitude, e after the latitude and f after the second longitude; L16, g after the latitude.
Marks not transcribed: L03, a speck of 5 by 5 px below «كا» of the longitude; small specks of the impression.
The editor's footnotes stand in three lines below a short rule at the left: notes a-g. The page number «— ١٥١ —» stands at the foot, centred.
